title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon across paid API and subscriber tiers
title.zhHans: Google 在付费 API 与订阅渠道推出 Gemini 4 Neon

searchSummary.en: On November 18, 2026, Google rolled out Gemini 4 Neon across the paid Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini for Business, Antigravity, and Pro/Ultra tiers; Vals AI independently ranked it #3 of 43 models on the Vals Index.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 18 日，Google 向付费 Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini for Business、Antigravity 及 Pro/Ultra 订阅层推出 Gemini 4 Neon；Vals AI 独立评测将其排在 Vals Index 43 款模型第 3 位。

summary.en: On November 18, 2026, Google announced and began rolling out Gemini 4 Neon across the paid Gemini API in Google AI Studio, Gemini for Business, Google Antigravity (for paid AI Pro and Ultra subscribers), and the Gemini app (Pro and Ultra), with Fairwind Program cybersecurity access following over several days. Independent evaluator Vals AI ranked Gemini 4 Neon #3 of 43 models on the Vals Index (69.23%) and #1 on Legal Research Bench, while an independent review highlighted its $3 per million input-token pricing alongside the omission of two stronger rivals from Google's comparison chart.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 18 日，Google 宣布并启动 Gemini 4 Neon 分层推送，覆盖 Google AI Studio 付费 Gemini API、Gemini for Business、Google Antigravity（付费 AI Pro/Ultra 订阅）与 Gemini 应用（Pro/Ultra），并称随后数日向 Fairwind 网络安全防御计划成员开放。独立评测机构 Vals AI 实测显示 Neon 在 Vals Index 43 款模型中位列第 3（69.23%）并在 Legal Research Bench 排第 1；独立分析同时关注其每百万输入 token 3 美元的定位，并指出 Google 对比表未纳入两款更强竞品。

narrative.en: Gemini 4 Neon extends Google's November Gemini 4 rollout cadence after Carbon (November 10) and Hydrogen (November 12), targeting high-speed end-to-end coding, knowledge-work, and science tasks at mid-tier pricing without a free tier. While independent Vals AI benchmarks—and Artificial Analysis scores cited by Google and independent reviewers—place Neon near the price-performance frontier, unaffiliated enterprise production adoption has not yet been independently established.
narrative.zhHans: 继 11 月 10 日 Carbon 与 11 月 12 日 Hydrogen 之后，Gemini 4 Neon 以中档定价（无免费层）主打高速端到端编程、知识工作与科研任务。尽管 Vals AI 独立评测以及 Google 与独立评论引述的 Artificial Analysis 分数将其排在性价比前沿，但无关联企业真实生产采用尚未得到独立验证。

text.en: On November 18, 2026, Google began rolling out Gemini 4 Neon across the paid Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Gemini for Business, Antigravity, and Gemini app Pro and Ultra tiers.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 18 日，Google 开始在付费 Gemini API、Google AI Studio、Gemini for Business、Antigravity 及 Gemini 应用 Pro/Ultra 订阅层推出 Gemini 4 Neon。

text.en: Independent benchmark testing by Vals AI ranked Gemini 4 Neon #3 of 43 models on the Vals Index (69.23%) and #1 on Legal Research Bench, while Google and independent commentary cited a 61 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score at $3 per million input tokens.
text.zhHans: Vals AI 独立基准评测将 Gemini 4 Neon 列为 Vals Index 43 款模型第 3（69.23%）及 Legal Research Bench 第 1；Google 与独立评论亦引述其在每百万输入 token 3 美元定价下取得 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 61 分。

description.en: Paid developer API and Pro/Ultra subscriber rollout brings near-flagship independently tested benchmark performance at mid-tier ($3 input) pricing, though no free tier is offered.
description.zhHans: 付费 API 与 Pro/Ultra 订阅开放使开发者和付费用户能以中档价格（每百万输入 token 3 美元）调用接近旗舰级独立评测表现的模型（无免费层）。
